gold_sql:
WITH candidates AS (
  SELECT p.id, p.geometry
  FROM pois p
  WHERE ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-74.327266 39.910289)',4326)::geography, 4500)
    AND p.amenity = 'restaurant'
),
poi_elev AS (
  SELECT c.id, elev.z
  FROM candidates c
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, c.geometry::geometry) AS z
    FROM public.dem_us d
    WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, c.geometry::geometry)
    LIMIT 1
  ) elev ON elev.z IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM poi_elev
WHERE z <= 320;

WITH refuge_point AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-74.327266, 39.910289), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
buffered_area AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Buffer(geom, 4500) AS geom
  FROM refuge_point
),
elevation_clip AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Clip(rast, 1, (SELECT geom FROM buffered_area), TRUE) AS clipped_rast
  FROM public.dem_us
  WHERE ST_Intersects(rast, (SELECT geom FROM buffered_area))
),
elevation_condition AS (
  SELECT 
    (ST_SummaryStats(clipped_rast, TRUE)).*
  FROM elevation_clip
),
valid_restaurants AS (
  SELECT 
    p.id
  FROM pois p
  WHERE 
    p.amenity = 'restaurant' AND
    ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, (SELECT geom FROM buffered_area), 0) AND
    ST_Value(
      (SELECT clipped_rast FROM elevation_clip),
      p.geometry::geometry,
      TRUE
    ) <= 320
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS restaurant_count
FROM valid_restaurants;
